# import phylo trees 
```{r, label="import trees",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Ectomycorrhizal
# Decomposer
# Inopinata

tree <- read.nexus("../OLD_trees/Dennytree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre") %>% ladderize(right=F)

tips <- tree$tip.label %>% data.frame %>% setNames("tip") # JASON piping the names of each species into a dataframe - name of column as tip

# Import spreadsheet with new tips and update them

new_tips <- read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv") # JASON wanted to update names of the species somehow- maybe something got moved or had its name changed - basically the spores need to match the tips of the tree- but we have two different trees, one from ben one from pringle lab

tree$tip.label <- as.character(new_tips[[2]][match(tree$tip.label, new_tips[[1]])])

# Color tree
compTree_colored <- tree
compTree_colored <-paintSubTree(compTree_colored,node=109,state="1",stem=F)
compTree_colored <-paintSubTree(compTree_colored,node=115,state="2",stem=T)
compTree_colored <-paintSubTree(compTree_colored,node=124,state="3",stem=T)
compTree_colored <-paintSubTree(compTree_colored,node=127,state="4",stem=T)

# Name corresponding colors 

cols<-c("black","deepskyblue","purple","orange"); names(cols)<-1:4

# 

```

```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)

# create an Out object

#spores <- Out(spores)

# JASON ADDED - More additions to alter and improve pca

out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
stack(out_spores)
```

```{r}
out_spores_centered <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
stack(out_spores_centered)
```

```{r}
out_spores_align <- Momocs::coo_align(out_spores_centered)
stack(out_spores_align)
```

```{r}
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores_align)
stack(out_spores_scaled)
```

```{r}
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
stack(out_spores_smoothed)
```

```{r}
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 21, norm = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# get names of the files to extract the species name

image_names <- data.frame(names(efourier_spores))
colnames(image_names) <- "image_name"

# now extract the epithet to calculate a mean shape for the outlines of each species

species <- colsplit(image_names$image_name,"_",names=c("genus","epithet","author"))
species$genus <- gsub("Amanita","A",species$genus)
species$species <- paste0(species$genus,"_",species$epithet) %>% as.factor

# Import groups by clade

groups <- read.csv("spreadsheets/Amanita_spore_groups.csv")

# join species with outlines and groups

groups <- left_join(species, groups, "species")

#groups$in_tree <- as.character(groups$in_tree)
#groups$in_tree[is.na(groups$in_tree)] <- "no"
#groups$clade <- as.character(groups$clade)
#groups$clade[is.na(groups$clade)] <- "not_in_tree"
groups[] <- lapply(groups[], factor)

# assign groups

efourier_spores$fac <- groups
```

# do the pca - once for mean spores by species once for all spores 

```{r}
efourier_spores_means <- MSHAPES(efourier_spores, 'species') # JASON this takes the mean shape of each species of spores
pca_spore_means <- PCA(efourier_spores_means$Coe) # JASON coe is elliptic forier coefficients

```

```{r}
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)
plot(pca_spores, main = "PCA of Amanita Spore Shapes (Fourier Analysis)")

```

# if eigen vectors are arbitrarily flipped, flip them back


```{r}

# Check if the principal components' correlations are negative and flip them accordingly
if (cor(pca_spores$rotation[,1], pca_spore_means$rotation[,1]) < 0) {
  pca_spore_means$rotation[,1] <- -pca_spore_means$rotation[,1]
  pca_spore_means$x[,1] <- -pca_spore_means$x[,1]  # Flip scores too
}

if (cor(pca_spores$rotation[,2], pca_spore_means$rotation[,2]) < 0) {
  pca_spore_means$rotation[,2] <- -pca_spore_means$rotation[,2]
  pca_spore_means$x[,2] <- -pca_spore_means$x[,2]  # Flip scores too
}

cor(pca_spores$rotation[,1], pca_spore_means$rotation[,1]) # Compare PC1

plot(pca_spore_means, main = "PCA of Mean Amanita Spore Shapes (Aligned Fourier Analysis)")

```

```{r, label="phylANOVA",fig.height=6, fig.width=7, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Drop outgroup for phylanova
amanita_only_tree <- extract.clade(compTree, node=88) 

compData_phylANOVA <- treedata(amanita_only_tree, pcs_spores) #JASON matches the tree with the spore data
compTree_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$phy
compData_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA[,2:4] <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA <- join(compData_phylANOVA,groups,match="first") 

compData_phylANOVA_clade<-compData_phylANOVA$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)
compData_phylANOVA_PC1<-compData_phylANOVA$PC1
names(compData_phylANOVA_PC1)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA, compData_phylANOVA_clade, compData_phylANOVA_PC1, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")
```

```{r, label="phylANOVA Ben tree",fig.height=6, fig.width=7, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Drop outgroup for phylanova

tree2 <- read.nexus("../OLD_trees/Bentree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre")
new_tips <- read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv")
tree2$tip.label <- as.character(new_tips[[2]][match(tree2$tip.label, new_tips[[1]])])

# Match tree and data

compData2 <- treedata(tree2, pcs_spores)
compTree2 <- compData2$phy
compData2 <- compData2$data %>% data.frame()
compData2[,2:4] <- sapply(compData2[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compTree2 <- compTree2 %>% ladderize(right=F) 

amanita_only_tree <- extract.clade(compTree2, node=88) 

compData_phylANOVA <- treedata(amanita_only_tree, pcs_spores)
compTree_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$phy
compData_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA[,2:4] <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA <- join(compData_phylANOVA,groups,match="first")

# Now make A. codinae, A. singeri, A. pruitii and A. inopinata group 1 since the tree is different
compData_phylANOVA$clade <- gsub("clade_2","clade_1",compData_phylANOVA$clade)


compData_phylANOVA_clade<-compData_phylANOVA$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)
compData_phylANOVA_PC1<-compData_phylANOVA$PC1
names(compData_phylANOVA_PC1)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA, compData_phylANOVA_clade, compData_phylANOVA_PC1, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")
```

## Fig. S3

```{r, label="PC1-Q regression",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
row.names(spore_length_width)<-spore_length_width$species
spore_length_width$Q<-spore_length_width$ave_length__m/spore_length_width$ave_width__m
spore_length_width$cuberootVolume<-((4/3)*pi*spore_length_width$ave_length__m*spore_length_width$ave_width__m^2)^(1/3)
spore_length_width$logcuberootVolume<-log(spore_length_width$cuberootVolume)

compData_length_width <- treedata(compTree, data=spore_length_width)
compTree_length_width<-compData_length_width$phy
compData_length_width <- compData_length_width$data %>% data.frame()
compData_length_width[,c(3:7)] <- sapply(compData_length_width[,c(3:7)], as.character) %>% as.numeric

compDataPC1<-treedata(compTree_length_width,data=pcs_spores)
compDataPC1 <- compDataPC1$data %>% data.frame()
compDataPC1[,c(2:4)] <- sapply(compDataPC1[,c(2:4)], as.character) %>% as.numeric

Q_PC1_comp<-data.frame(Q=compData_length_width[sort(row.names(compData_length_width)),colnames(compData_length_width)=="Q"], 
                       PC1=compDataPC1[sort(row.names(compDataPC1)),colnames(compDataPC1)=="PC1"])

cor.test(Q_PC1_comp$Q,Q_PC1_comp$PC1)

ggscatter(Q_PC1_comp, x = "Q", y = "PC1", 
          add = "reg.line", conf.int = TRUE, 
          cor.coef = TRUE, cor.method = "pearson",
          xlab = "Q", ylab = "PC1")

```

```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on Ben's tree",fig.height=6, results="hide",eval=T,fig.width=8, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
l1ouPC1tree_2<-adjust_data(PC1OUtree_2,PC1OUdata_2)
set.seed(101)
estimate_shift_PC1_2<-estimate_shift_configuration(l1ouPC1tree_2$tree, l1ouPC1tree_2$Y, criterion="pBIC")

##update tip labels
estimate_shift_PC1_2$tree$tip.label<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(estimate_shift_PC1_2$tree$tip.label, new_tips[[2]])])
row.names(estimate_shift_PC1_2$Y)<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(row.names(estimate_shift_PC1_2$Y), new_tips[[2]])])

plot(estimate_shift_PC1_2,cex=0.5)
```

```{r, label="phylogenetic ANOVA volume",fig.height=6,,fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# phylogenetic ANOVA with tree1

compData_phylANOVA_volume <- treedata(amanita_only_tree, compData_length_width)
compTree_phylANOVA_volume <- compData_phylANOVA_volume$phy
compData_phylANOVA_volume <- compData_phylANOVA_volume$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume, as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA_volume <- join(compData_phylANOVA_volume,groups,match="first")


compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)
compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA_volume, compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade, compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")

# phylogenetic ANOVA with tree2

# Drop outgroup for phylanova
amanita_only_tree2 <- extract.clade(compTree2, node=88)

compData_phylANOVA_volume <- treedata(amanita_only_tree2, compData_length_width)
compTree_phylANOVA_volume <- compData_phylANOVA_volume$phy
compData_phylANOVA_volume <- compData_phylANOVA_volume$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume, as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA_volume <- join(compData_phylANOVA_volume,groups,match="first")

# Now make A. codinae, A. singeri, A. pruitii and A. inopinata group 1 since the tree is different
compData_phylANOVA_volume$clade <- gsub("clade_2","clade_1",compData_phylANOVA_volume$clade)

compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)
compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA_volume, compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade, compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")

```

```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on volume calculation",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Volume<-as.matrix(compData_length_width[,c(5:7)])[,3]
```


```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on volume",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
result_Volume<-readRDS("results/result_log_cuberoot_volume_bootstrap_analysis.rds")
nEdges_Volume <- Nedge(l1ouVolumetree$tree)
e.w_Volume <- rep(1,nEdges_Volume) 
e.w_Volume[estimate_shift_Volume$shift.configuration] <- 3

e.l_Volume <- ifelse(e.l_Volume>20, paste0(e.l_Volume,"%"), NA)

##update tip labels
estimate_shift_Volume$tree$tip.label<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(estimate_shift_Volume$tree$tip.label, new_tips[[2]])])
```
